84eb381414224afaa0f72ceb88e57ed9.value:
PHASE 1 — Counter billing parity.

4 tables (service_master, bills, bill_items, payments).
Reproduces the existing production HIMS OPD counter
flow exactly: find/create patient (EMPI), conditional
reg fee, per-doctor consultation fee, bill-level
discount %, single payment (cash/card/UPI/cheque)
where amount paid = total, Create-Visit in one click,
print receipt.

Per-doctor consultation pricing: lazy catalog
explosion (one service_master row per
(consultation type, doctor)) — matches production,
no price-agreement abstraction yet.

Out of scope here (Phase 2):
  • price_agreements
  • patient_advances + advance_utilizations
  • discount_approvals (workflow; bill-level
    discount % stays)
  • insurance / corporate / packages
Phase 3: refunds / plans / IPD final
Phase 4: doctor commissions

Later-phase columns on Phase 1 tables
(insurance_*, corporate_client_id, policy_id,
discharge_date, etc.) trimmed for review clarity.
Full schema in schema-reference.json. ADR-0025.
